mapper.select: select PRD_DESIGN_ID prdDesignId, PRD_SCALE prdScale from MOCK_RESULT_INFO where 1=1 and PRD_DESIGN_ID = #{prdDesignId} and MOCK_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mockDate},'%Y-%m-%d') order by GENERATE_TIME desc

select deal.asset_type assetType, deal.asset_risk_level assetRiskLevel, deal.mock_amt mockAmt, deal.mock_share_amt mockShareAmt, rate.rate_type rateType, case when rate.rate_type = #{INT_TYPE_01} then rate.spread_rate_max else CONCAT_WS('',rate.index_id_max_str , '*' , rate.coefficient_max , '+' , rate.spread_rate_max) end rateMax, case when rate.rate_type = #{INT_TYPE_01} then rate.spread_rate_min else CONCAT_WS('',rate.index_id_min_str , '*' , rate.coefficient_min , '+' , rate.spread_rate_min) end rateMix, rate.index_id_max benchmarkMax, rate.index_source_max benchmarkMaxSource, rate.index_id_min benchmarkMin, rate.index_source_min benchmarkMinSource, rate.coefficient_max coefficientMax, rate.coefficient_min coefficientMin, rate.spread_rate_max spreadRateMax, rate.spread_rate_min spreadRateMin, deal.batch_id batchId from MOCK_TRADE_DEAL deal inner join MOCK_RESULT_INFO info on info.prd_design_id = deal.prd_design_id and info.batch_id = deal.batch_id left join (select rate1.trade_id trade_id, rate1.rate_type rate_type, rate1.index_id index_id_max, dict1.item_value index_id_max_str, rate1.index_source index_source_max, rate2.index_id index_id_min, dict2.item_value index_id_min_str, rate2.index_source index_source_min, rate1.coefficient coefficient_max, rate2.coefficient coefficient_min, rate1.spread_rate spread_rate_max, rate2.spread_rate spread_rate_min from MOCK_TRADE_RATE rate1 inner join MOCK_TRADE_RATE rate2 on rate1.trade_id = rate2.trade_id and rate2.rate_mnclass = #{RATE_MNCLASS_02} left join sys_datadict_list dict1 on dict1.item_code = rate1.index_id and dict1.dict_code in (#{SECRATE_DATA},#{MARKET_ID},#{CURVE_CODE}) left join sys_datadict_list dict2 on dict2.item_code = rate2.index_id and dict2.dict_code in (#{SECRATE_DATA},#{MARKET_ID},#{CURVE_CODE}) where rate1.rate_mnclass = #{RATE_MNCLASS_01} ) rate on rate.trade_id = deal.trade_id where 1=1 and info.data_status = #{DATA_STATUS_01} and info.seq_no = #{seqNo}

SELECT T.INT_RATE_ID intRateId, T.INT_RATE_TYPE intRateType, T.EFF_DATE effDate, T.RELAESE_DATE relaeseDate, T.INT_RATE intRate, T.CCY ccy, T.INPUT_TYPE inputType FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T WHERE T.INT_RATE_ID = #{benchmark} AND T.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mockDate},'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY T.EFF_DATE DESC
